note: Family-run campground on 63 acres of rolling hills 5 miles north of Pioneer, on the Ohio-Michigan line and 10 minutes from I-80/90. Cabins, a pool and swimming pond, propane, and activities every weekend from Memorial Day through Labor Day. The age requirement to camp is 21. --Claude
